articleTitle: Railroad Near-Miss Occurrence Detection and Risk Estimation System with Data from Camera Using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Imaging, Signal Processing and Communications (ICISPC)
abstract: An unsafe railway operation system has both direct and indirect societal consequences. Railway accidents are a major safety and financial issue for the railroad industry. Estimating the risk of railway accidents is critical for safety, as it will support in the development of secure railway operations and reduce the further risks associated with railway systems. For many years, researchers have explored various techniques for obstacles detection and early detection of railroad accidents to aid in railway incident management. With recent advancements in machine learning algorithms and data collection techniques, there are a growing number of research studies to provide suitable solutions for the railway safety system. In this paper, we present a novel approach for detecting near-miss occurrences and estimating the risk of event with data from camera using deep learning models. Our proposed approach detects and localizes foreign objects on the railroad. It also detects the position of rail tracks using a segmentation method to estimate the risk of near-miss occurrence by calculating the distance between the detected objects to the rail track. A proposed approach successfully analyzed input image into a rail track segmentation and detection of foreign objects on rail track. Experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed approach and its suitability for a complex real-world railway systems.

articleTitle: Classification for Tomato Disease with Imbalanced Samples Based on TD-MobileNetV2
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Imaging, Signal Processing and Communications (ICISPC)
abstract: Image classification based on deep learning requires a large number of training samples. The main obstacle, from a practical perspective, has been difficult sample obtaining of several disease categories. The key task of this paper is to solve the problem of bad accuracy performance and low robustness influenced by imbalanced dataset. In the stage of image pre-processing, weighted random sampling algorithm and data augmentation techniques are applied to match up different category samples consistent. A CNN architecture based on MobileNetV2 and targeted dropout algorithm is proposed to improve the robustness of the conventional model. Results demonstrate that the proposed model achieves a performance very close to that of conventional CNN architecture. Moreover, the detrimental effects of Gaussian and Salt&Pepper noise is weakened, and the technique offers significant performance gain on complex background samples over the traditional deep learning methods.

articleTitle: A Massive MIMO Signal Detection Method Based on ZF Method
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Imaging, Signal Processing and Communications (ICISPC)
abstract: The 5th generation communication technology(5G) is becoming more and more significant so that almost major economies in the world has invested numerous resource in the construction of communication technology. However, Massive MIMO which is one of the 5G core technology bumps into an inevitable challenge how to calculate the inverse of large-scale more efficiently and apace. There are many method based on iterative algorithm in convergence condition such as Gauss-Seidel method. All of those methods relay on the short way of the special shape matrix to reckon inverse. They can not work well in inadequate iterations. Hence, we propose a novel zero-forcing method to solve the problem about how to reckon inverse in another way based on matrix inversion lemma and dismantling matrix.

articleTitle: Lung Nodule Classification of CT Images Based on the Deep Learning Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Imaging, Signal Processing and Communications (ICISPC)
abstract: Early diagnosis and treatment of lung cancer patients can help to reduce a lung cancer mortality rate that contributes to more than 11.6% of the total cancer-associated deaths. Usually, for patients' diagnosis, Computed Tomography (CT) images are manually diagnosed by radiologists, which is a huge burden to them and sometimes leads to inaccuracy. Therefore, an automated computer-aided diagnosis (CAD) system that can assist radiologists in decision-making is preferable to speed up patients' diagnosis and overcome inaccuracy. This study aims to develop an automated CAD system algorithm that uses a deep Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) for in-depth feature extraction to classify benign and malignant lung nodules from a chest CT scan. The CSPNet and PANet modules are used to combine with the ResNet model for CT scan feature extraction. Due to the multidimensional (3D) nature of CT scans, we propose to use 3D convolutional kernels. We validated the proposed network on CT scan from The Lung Nodule Analysis 2016 (LUNA16) public dataset, which comprises of 888 CT scans. Experimental results show that the proposed algorithm gives a specificity, sensitivity, accuracy, and AUC of 98.98%, 94.42%, 97.09%, and 0.995, respectively. In addition, the results of our design show competitiveness compared to other studies.

articleTitle: Design of Ghost-free Aerial Display by Using Polarizing Plate and Dihedral Corner Reflector Array
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Imaging, Signal Processing and Communications (ICISPC)
abstract: A dihedral corner reflector array (DCRA) is an optical system that displays images in the air. It faces a drawback of reduced visibility of the aerial image due to stray light, which is referred to as a ghost. The formation of a ghost can be suppressed by providing a louver; however, this reduces the viewing angle of the aerial image. This study proposes a design of a ghost-free aerial display using polarizing plates and a DCRA. The experimental results verify that the proposed method suppressed the brightness of the ghost to approximately 23% or less compared to using only the DCRA. Additionally, at an observation angle of 45°, the proposed method obtained a brighter aerial image and ghost than the louver method.

articleTitle: Constant False Alarm OMP Algorithm Based on Sparse ISAR Imaging of Stationary Aircraft Target
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Imaging, Signal Processing and Communications (ICISPC)
abstract: Compressive Sensing (CS) is a widely used theory which indicates that a signal satisfies sparsity can be reconstructed below Nyquist sampling rate. ISAR imaging usually requires large amounts of data and long periods of observation to ensure high resolution. Through CS theory, the original signal of ISAR can be recovered under a small amount of observed data, reducing the requirement of data volume and the impact of data missing. Greedy algorithms are extensively used as one kind of CS algorithms because it’s more rapidly to find a solution. Orthogonal matching pursuit (OMP) algorithm is the typical algorithm in greedy algorithms. However, CS algorithms usually need more computational time with little data while conventional algorithms. Reducing the computational time is one research direction of CS. In this paper, a Constant False Alarm OMP (CFAR-OMP) algorithm is proposed which simplifies the iteration times. By setting the detection threshold through CFAR, the proposed algorithm only selects atoms in a single cyclic step, effectively reducing the calculation time on the premise of guaranteeing the reconstruction performance. The performance of the proposed algorithm is verified by the comparison of simulation and reconstruction with common thresholds. Finally, through the sparse ISAR imaging experiment of stationary aircraft target, the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm is proved from the simulation and measured data.

articleTitle: A Real-Time Target Tracking Algorithm Based on Improved Kernel Correlation Filter
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Imaging, Signal Processing and Communications (ICISPC)
abstract: At present, target tracking technology is a popular computer vision technology, which is of great significance in people's production and life. But there are still some important and difficult problems in the field of target tracking, such as background similarity, target occlusion, motion blur and so on. Although the target tracking method based on deep learning has good robustness, its off-line training process costs a lot of time and is not flexible enough to use. In this paper, starting from the background requirements of shipboard platform sea target tracking, the algorithm is improved based on kernel correlation filtering algorithm, and a set of high robust real-time target tracking algorithm based on online learning method is proposed.

articleTitle: Internet Protocol Version 6 Migration
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Imaging, Signal Processing and Communications (ICISPC)
abstract: With the rapid development of the Internet, the continuous increase of Internet users and the increasing demand for Internet applications, IPv4 (Internet Protocol Version 4), the mainstream technology of Internet communication, is facing more and more bottlenecks in reality. Although the current IPV4 network is still Occupying a leading position, some of its limitations have been widely concerned. The International Organization for Standardization---Internet Engineering Task Force (IFTF) has started the research and development of the next-generation Internet protocol Ipgn since the early 1990s. In the mid-1990s, the sixth version of the Internet Protocol-IPv6 was launched. As an upgrade of IPV4, due to the influence of technology and financial resources, IPv6 will not completely replace IPv4 in the short term, and the two will experience a transition (coexistence)-replacing such a long-term process. Therefore, the current research on migration technology from IPV4 to IPv6 has positive practical significance. This paper firstly analyzes the limitations of IPv4 protocol and then discusses the improvements and advantages of IPv6 protocol. Finally, the paper comes to the conclusion that IPv4 and IPv6 will coexist for a long time after summarizing and analyzing the migration from IPv4 to IPv6.

articleTitle: Detection of Anal Sac Disease, Atresia Ani and Rectal Prolapse for Canis Lupus Familiaris Using Image Processing and Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Imaging, Signal Processing and Communications (ICISPC)
abstract: This research focuses on using deep learning for android devices in identifying three anal diseases of dogs. The advantage of using this method is to continually improve its accuracy every time it is used. The researchers chose MobileNetV2, a model of Convolutional Neural Network for mobile devices. After training the model with 111 images per disease, an accuracy of 94% is achieved.

articleTitle: Investigation of Gas/Oil/Water Distribution Based on Electrical Capacitance and Microwave Tomography
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Imaging, Signal Processing and Communications (ICISPC)
abstract: The extraction and transportation of crude oil is a typical multiphase flow process. In order to visualize the oil/gas/water distribution, simulation and static tests are carried out in this paper. Electrical capacitance tomography (ECT) and microwave tomography (MWT) carried out static imaging tests of oil-gas two-phase flow and oil-water two-phase flow. Landweber iteration is used as the image reconstruction algorithm of ECT. The simulation results show that the normalized capacitance model, the iteration number and the step length have a certain influence on the ECT image reconstruction. Static tests show that ECT and MWT have a certain complementarity for oil/gas/water distribution. For oil-water flow, the image quality of MWT is better than that of ECT, and for oil-gas flow, the image quality of ECT is better than that of MWT. For a specific flow pattern, MWT image data can be used as the initial value of the ECT image reconstruction algorithm to further improve the accuracy of the ECT image.

articleTitle: Performance Evaluation of Speech Enhancement of Single Acoustic Signal Referring to Image Information
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Imaging, Signal Processing and Communications (ICISPC)
abstract: This paper presents performance evaluation of speech enhancement of an acoustic signal referring to image information. In recent years, we often see smart phones and tablets in everyday life. Smart phones and tablets have a camera and a microphone. Although many speech enhancement techniques use only the audio information from microphones, it is considered that visual information from a camera is also helpful to enhance the speech. Although the frame rate of the normal movie is very low compared to the sampling frequency of the audio signal, it is useful if it is adequately used. We investigated the performance depending on the parameters and confirmed its effectiveness through the experiments.

articleTitle: Design and Development of Virtual Scene of " Birds paying homage to the Phoenix " Based on Virtual Reality Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Imaging, Signal Processing and Communications (ICISPC)
abstract: Virtual and augmented reality technology is increasingly used in the field of cultural creation, and intangible cultural heritage has become an important element in the field of cultural creation. Taking the intangible cultural heritage Suona art as an example, based on the analysis of Suona art background, development and communication status, this paper puts forward the design idea of the Suona virtual scene system. Using virtual display development engine Unreal Engine 4 and data import plug-in Datasmith, combined with LBS (location-based service) technology, the design and construction of the Suona art virtual scene are realized. The system analyzes the artistic characteristics of Suona's famous song " Birds paying homage to the Phoenix" and integrates it into the crescent spring scenic spot, which improves the immersion, interactivity and imagination of the scene experience. At the same time, the interactive system provides new ideas and effective practical solutions for the spread of Suona's intangible cultural heritage culture.

Author Keywords: birds paying homage to the Phoenix

articleTitle: Joint Robust Transmit and Receive Beamforming Based on Probability Constraint
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Imaging, Signal Processing and Communications (ICISPC)
abstract: In this paper, a robust beamforming technique is considered by means of joint transmit array and receive array optimization. The proposed joint beamformer can adjust the transmit beam pattern and the receive beam pattern simultaneously to match the target and null the interferences. A probability constraint on the distortionless response is imposed to model robust formulation. The proposed non-convex formulation is decomposed into two parallel second order cone programming (SOCP) problems, and the optimal beamformer is obtained by solving these two SOCP problems in a sequential order. Numerical simulations show that the proposed beamformer is robust against model mismatch errors and outperforms the conventional robust beamformers at the receiver array.

articleTitle: Detecting Falling Rocks by Estimating Excavation Points Using Laser Pointer
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Imaging, Signal Processing and Communications (ICISPC)
abstract: Tunnels have been constructed in various locations for transportation and lifelines. During the tunnel construction, industrial accidents occur owing to falling rocks from the tunnel face. Numerous falling rocks was confirmed in the precursor of the tunnel collapse. Therefore, it is necessary to detect falling rocks to prevent industrial accidents and understand the situation on the tunnel face. In conventional methods, the inter-frame difference method and laser measurement method have been proposed. However, it is difficult to monitor the entire tunnel face and detect moving objects other than falling rocks. In this study, we propose a falling rocks detection method that combines the moving object detection method on the tunnel face and the estimation method of excavation points using single color markers. It was confirmed that only falling rocks were detected during excavation experiments.

articleTitle: Explainable Sentence-Level Sentiment Analysis for Amazon Product Reviews
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Imaging, Signal Processing and Communications (ICISPC)
abstract: In this paper, we conduct a sentence-level sentiment analysis on the product reviews from Amazon and thorough analysis on the model’s interpretability. For the sentiment analysis task, we mainly use the Bi-LSTM model with attention mechanism. For the study of interpretability, we consider the attention weights distribution of single sentence and the attention weights of main aspect terms. The model has an accuracy of up to 96%. And we find that the aspect terms have the same or even more attention weights than the sentimental words in sentences.

articleTitle: Finger Movement Recognition for Virtual Keyboard Based on sEMG
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Imaging, Signal Processing and Communications (ICISPC)
abstract: Disabled forelimb has been a main obstacle for people to communicate with computer by keyboard. To achieve the interface with computer, most of them have to use voice commands to interact with it. But this kind of interface has many inconveniences, such as the inability of using it in both noisy and quiet places as well as inadequate provision of commands compared to keyboard. Surface electromyography (sEMG)is a kind of signal that is created when muscles start to contract or the brain produces nerve impulses for muscle contraction. Also the existence of sEMG signals does not depend on the integrity of hands. This project aims to explore the possibility of exploiting sEMG signals to realize that the disabled can interact with the computer through the keyboard. We designed a series of hand movements (sEMG signals) and made them correspond one-to-one with specific strings. By detecting and recognizing the sEMG signals of muscles, the disabled can use the virtual keyboard to interact with the computer normally. In addition, we also designed a signal processing method based on multi-class support vector machine (SVM) with error-correcting output code (ECOC) and label-threshold pre-process. It helps patients in need create their own sEMG signal recognition model. Traditional signal processing method with floating window can accurately identify each action, but it will output the classification results of each action several times, which will cause great inconvenience to the use of the virtual keyboard. This new signal processing method with ECOC and pre-process greatly avoids this problem.

articleTitle: The Research on the Impact of Visual Image Perception in a User Interface on Typeface Design
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Imaging, Signal Processing and Communications (ICISPC)
abstract: Nowadays, Typeface plays an increasingly important role in dynamic digital interfaces, but there still has little direct evaluation of visual image perception related to the typeface design, especially for the use in interface typography. The research is based on the analysis of display screen, elaborates upon the connection between display resolution and typeface design, the relationship between display polarity and the principle of vision optics. Furthermore, essential attributes and requirements of the two genre of interface font are inspected from the human visual image perception. Additionally, the visual processing of text information and visual characteristics in scanning state are elaborated, visual Angle and spatial frequency of visual perception are identified as the cornerstones influencing the design of a typeface for user interface. The methodology of visual perception can be adapted to investigate questions relevant to typographic and typeface design.
